blocks.text: Following the viral success of her previous single ‘The Jester and The Queen’, Perth based alt-pop singer/songwriter Alexandria returns with her mischievous new release, ‘Ghost in My Walls’. Trading the medieval romance of her previous releases for more of a macabre, high-energy sound; the track delivers a fun, upbeat dive into the supernatural. Penned during an international songwriting camp in Thailand, the song was inspired by Alexandria’s stay in a hotel rumored to be haunted. The distinct whistling, subtle knocking, and eerie finger-tapping threaded throughout the song are actual recordings captured inside her Bangkok hotel room, deliberately left raw and unpolished.
